blockers.title: Docker execution unavailable
blockers.unblock: Use a Docker-enabled local machine or authorised CI/CodeBuild runner; retain build/run logs.

blockers.title: AWS deployment access unavailable
blockers.evidence: AWS CLI absent; no AWS auth source detected; plugin discovery found analytics functionality, not an infrastructure deployment connection.
blockers.unblock: Establish a scoped, authorised AWS deployment context and verify account, role, Region and permitted actions. No credentials in chat.

blockers.title: Application-level live source path has not passed
blockers.evidence: CLI returned 44 formats with system CA trust; actual application request returned 502 source-restriction error. Full real file transfer is unverified.
blockers.unblock: Investigate supported app/runtime behaviour, then pass controlled source-to-worker-to-device tests with authorised media and the actual AWS image/network. Preserve failure details; do not treat a fixture as proof.

blockers.title: Native PostgreSQL execution requires another runtime
blockers.evidence: Schema/repository implemented and PGlite SQL/HTTP tests passed. Native binaries installed; root-only UID namespace prevents non-root initdb execution (chown EINVAL). No native concurrency/TLS target supplied.
blockers.unblock: Run the provided native suite in a mapped non-root environment or with a disposable TEST_DATABASE_URL. Preserve the single-backend/native distinction.
blockers.owner: Docker/non-root runner or disposable database context
